Major UX and feature update. Heavily tested on 11.6. Treat this as the primary development build — all features are active and working.

**Conflict Overwrite and Merge Prompts**: Copy and Move now detect naming conflicts before starting the task. Browser confirm dialog shows Overwrite? for files or Merge? for folders. Skip continues to the next item; Confirm retries with overwrite=1.
**Checkbox Multi-Selection**: Every row has an individual checkbox for controller-friendly multi-select (no Ctrl/Shift needed). A Select All master checkbox in the header toggles all items at once.

**Interactive Image Viewer**: Built-in viewer for .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .webp, .ico, .svg. Supports grab-and-drag panning, mouse-wheel zooming (0.1x to 10x), 90 degree rotation, and a Reset button. Double-click to open, Escape to close.

**Multi-Log Viewer with PS5 Error History Decoder**: The log button now shows a dropdown to select: BFpilot log, Archive log, Search crawler log, Boot log, PS5 VSH log, or PS5 Error History. The Error History option crawls /system_data/priv/error/history/, decodes Sony JSON crash records (error codes, Title IDs, firmware version, ticks) and displays them as a readable trace list. Auto-refreshes every 2 seconds.
Permission Bypass: Global umask(0) at process start plus chmod/fchmod 0777 hooks on all created files, folders, and uploads.
Split ZIP Support: Full support for official (.z01/.zip) and raw (.zip.001/.zip.002) multi-volume split ZIP archives.
Extract Dialog Default Target: Extract dialog now pre-fills the destination from the active Target panel path.
This release contains structural performance, memory efficiency, and usability optimizations.

**Graceful Exit & Re-injection**:
Implemented loopback TCP wakeup to unblock the socket `accept()` loop instantly during shutdown.
Added graceful exit flags to terminate background archive daemon and search crawler threads cleanly.
Web port `5905` and loader port `9021` release instantly on exit, allowing payload re-injection without console reboots.
**Fast Multi-Threaded Search Indexing**:
Added a work-stealing concurrent crawler thread pool for filesystem indexing.
